scripts.package: node build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename finnsikt.xpi
scripts.source: mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && rm -f web-ext-artifacts/finnsikt-source.zip && jj file list | zip -q web-ext-artifacts/finnsikt-source.zip -@
scripts.sign: node build.mjs && pnpm source && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/finnsikt-source.zip
